name: @pipeworx/mcp-weatherapi

tools.name: current
tools.description: Get current/real-time weather for a location, including temperature, condition, humidity, wind, UV, and air quality (AQI). Location can be a city name, "lat,lon", zip code, or IATA airport code. Example: current({ q: "London", aqi: true }).

q.description: Location — city name (e.g. "London"), "lat,lon" (e.g. "48.8567,2.3508"), US/UK/Canada zip/postcode, IATA airport code (e.g. "DXB"), or "auto:ip". NOTE on IATA codes: WeatherAPI resolves them to that airport's CITY, not the airport's own weather station — for the actual airport-station reading (can differ by several degrees) use the aviation-weather pack's metar tool with the airport's ICAO code instead.

aqi.description: Include air quality (AQI) data. Default true.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own WeatherAPI.com API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

tools.name: forecast
tools.description: Get a multi-day weather forecast for a location: daily high/low temperature, condition, chance of rain, total precipitation, and sunrise/sunset times. Up to 10 days. Example: forecast({ q: "Tokyo", days: 5 }).

q.description: Location — city name (e.g. "London"), "lat,lon" (e.g. "48.8567,2.3508"), US/UK/Canada zip/postcode, IATA airport code (e.g. "DXB"), or "auto:ip". NOTE on IATA codes: WeatherAPI resolves them to that airport's CITY, not the airport's own weather station — for the actual airport-station reading (can differ by several degrees) use the aviation-weather pack's metar tool with the airport's ICAO code instead.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own WeatherAPI.com API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

tools.name: astronomy
tools.description: Get astronomy data for a location and date: sunrise, sunset, moonrise, moonset, moon phase, and moon illumination. Example: astronomy({ q: "Reykjavik", dt: "2026-06-21" }).

q.description: Location — city name (e.g. "London"), "lat,lon" (e.g. "48.8567,2.3508"), US/UK/Canada zip/postcode, IATA airport code (e.g. "DXB"), or "auto:ip". NOTE on IATA codes: WeatherAPI resolves them to that airport's CITY, not the airport's own weather station — for the actual airport-station reading (can differ by several degrees) use the aviation-weather pack's metar tool with the airport's ICAO code instead.

dt.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format (optional; defaults to today).

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own WeatherAPI.com API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

tools.name: marine
tools.description: Get marine/ocean conditions forecast for a coastal location: significant wave height, swell height, water temperature, and wind. Up to 7 days, sampled every 6 hours. Example: marine({ q: "33.7,-118.4", days: 2 }).

q.description: Location — city name (e.g. "London"), "lat,lon" (e.g. "48.8567,2.3508"), US/UK/Canada zip/postcode, IATA airport code (e.g. "DXB"), or "auto:ip". NOTE on IATA codes: WeatherAPI resolves them to that airport's CITY, not the airport's own weather station — for the actual airport-station reading (can differ by several degrees) use the aviation-weather pack's metar tool with the airport's ICAO code instead.

days.description: Number of marine forecast days (default 1, max 7).

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own WeatherAPI.com API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-weatherapi forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the weatherapi pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
